gloss: last place; lowest rank; bottom position

definitions.gloss: last place; lowest rank; bottom position
definitions.explanation: The lowest position in a ranking, competition, or hierarchy. The very bottom of a list or standings.

examples.japanese: {最下位|さいかい}に{終|お}わった。
このチームは{三年|さんねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{最下位|さいかい}だ。
examples.english: This team has been in last place for three years in a row.

examples.japanese: {最下位|さいかい}から{這|は}い{上|あ}がって{優勝|ゆうしょう}するのは{簡単|かんたん}なことではない。
examples.english: Climbing up from last place to win the championship is no easy feat.

notes:
Composed of {最|さい} (most) + {下位|かい} (lower rank). The superlative form of {下位|かい}, meaning the very lowest position.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最下位|さいかい}に{沈|しず}む: to sink to last place
- {最下位|さいかい}から{脱出|だっしゅつ}する: to escape last place
- {最下位|さいかい}に{終|お}わる: to finish in last place
- {最下位|さいかい}{争|あらそ}い: a battle to avoid last place
- ダントツ{最下位|さいかい}: dead last by a wide margin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下位|かい}: lower rank — a relative position, not necessarily the very bottom
- ビリ: last place — a more casual, colloquial word
- {最上位|さいじょうい}: top rank — the opposite, the highest position
- {首位|しゅい}: first place, the lead — the top of the standings

NOTE:
Commonly used in sports standings, exam rankings, and corporate performance comparisons. The casual synonym ビリ is more common in everyday conversation, while {最下位|さいかい} is used in formal or written contexts.
